quest.title: Where His Life Lies
quest.description: You see a familiar face in the Court of Fontaine...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: ...Sir, perhaps we should go to Petrichor Village first.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Though Messrs. Xavier and Félix are not there, Messrs. Mécantre and Babisse should still be in the village.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Mayhap they can give you some suggestions or inspire you. Even in the worst-case scenario, you'll have two receptacles to pour your troubles into.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: No, my dear Lutong, no... Mécantre and Babisse's research is now blazing brightly, blazing a trail like a wildfire through dry tinder.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: In their last letter to me, they indicated that an intelligent man from the Fontaine Research Institute had arrived in Petrichor.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: This Mr. Bossuet fellow is quite knowledgeable and perceptive, and helped them resolve a number of issues...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: And as for me... *sigh*

choices.text: Garcia?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: #Truly an unexpected meeting, {NICKNAME}. We never imagined we'd see you in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Though... your timing is... as impeccable as always.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: #Indeed, truly impeccable timing... But still, we are happy to see you, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, they look exhausted! Such dark circles around their eyes... It's like they don't have any energy left at all!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's wrong, Garcia?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Our... erm... His research encountered some... unprecedented problems.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: But it's a very long story... Now, we're planning to go to the Opera Epiclese to help them close their books.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: After our work is done, we can all find a quiet place to sit down and have a chat.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You still have other work to do?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It can't really be called work. Just being hired here and there to assist with various calculations.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: The Opera Epiclese recently hosted a whole host of troupes, and urgently need to settle their accounts.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: So, to earn enough to cover the costs of returning to Petrichor, we... I, in place of Mr. Garcia, will accept the commission.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Tch! It's like using a cannon to eradicate an anthill! "Calculations" like those are so simple a child could do them. I could do it all in an afternoon even without using the Numbering Machine!

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: So this is an excellent way to raise funds. Let's set off right away, Sir.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, could I trouble you to accompany us?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: With your reputation preceding us on the road, perhaps we'll manage to avoid running into any unnecessary trouble.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Rest assured, we'll pay you appropriate remuneration for the trouble.

choices.text: Alright then.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: If I were you, I wouldn't make any hasty assumptions... hehe. At any rate, we should get going.

choices.text: You shouldn't run into any trouble in the city.
You've returned to Fontaine?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Though it must be said, this opera house is magnificent. It must bring in quite the pretty sum...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: The opera house... *sigh* Let's set off and get to work. Once we're done, we'll return to Petrichor Village.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: When we're back, I'll open up a bakery there and never touch another Numbering Machine again.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Uh... Sir...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: What's wrong, Lutong? You look like you've seen a ghost!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: It really is... a ghost...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Garcia...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ms. Kaia!? What's she doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't this quite the coincidence...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, what you just said wasn't particularly polite.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Oh, shut it, Lutong.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: #Garcia... Such a pleasure to bump into you, and you too, {NICKNAME}. Let me guess, you've come to help the opera house settle their accounts?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could it be that the account he's planning to settle is...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Of course not! Our troupe has never performed here.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: From what I know of Garcia though, he's not the type to watch opera in his spare time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: So the only reason he'd come to the opera house would be... because he was hired to work here, no?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: From the bottom of my heart, I feel you are more suitable to accompany this gentleman than I am, Ms. Kaia.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Every one of us is irreplaceable, my dear Lutong.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I... uh... I'm very happy to see you Kaia, I...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: ...You don't look all that happy, I must say. I presume your research hit a snag?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How'd you figure that out?

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Well, he certainly wouldn't be unhappy to see me, or because of you or Lutong...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: The only thing that could make him this unhappy is that Numbering Machine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How do you know Garcia so well, Ms. Kaia? You haven't seen each other for so long...

choices.text: Perhaps it's her intuition.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Perhaps we should find a café where we can sit down and have a nice leisurely chat? This isn't really something that can be explained in just a few words.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I still need to... Uh, I mean, I'm very happy... But we...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Relax, Sir. Those calculations are quite simple, I can handle them all myself.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: ...After all, you can't just make Ms. Kaia stand there and wait for us to finish, can you?

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: Thank you, Lutong, you're very considerate. We'll bring you back a cup of coffee.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Thank you, Miss. Enjoy your drink with Mr. Garcia.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Kaia and Garcia leave together...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So they're off for coffee, just like that...? This whole thing had nothing to do with us from the start!

choices.text: Nothing to do with us at all...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: #Not so, {NICKNAME}. What comes next is your actual commission.

choices.text: Do I have to fetch cooking ingredients?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Very amusing. But I don't intend to waste your time.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Mr. Garcia and I... We're actually in danger right now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh... Eh!?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Let's discuss it over there.

choices.text: Do I have to fetch parts?
Why don't I go take some pictures for them?
...So what are we even doing here?
Perhaps Garcia's not the toughest nut to crack.

talks.objective: Go to a more secluded place with Lutong

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: ...We should be fine here.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Let me start from the beginning. Since you helped us with the Numbering Machine in Sumeru, its performance has come on leaps and bounds.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Naturally, Mr. Garcia was very excited, and wanted to continue improving it. But as he said, the transmission structure of traditional mechanisms is actually quite limited...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: We were no longer making any new performance breakthroughs with this Numbering Machine, so we decided to return to Fontaine to search for new inspiration and research ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: But after we returned, Mr. Garcia was approached by a strange fellow.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: He claimed he could provide research funds, and even help Mr. Garcia find other research partners.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: But there was a catch — he wanted Mr. Garcia to share all of his designs and data with him.

choices.text: There's no way Garcia would accept that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Asking someone to hand over their research findings right from the get-go, surely that's just theft plain and simple!?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Exactly. So Mr. Garcia emphatically refused the offer.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: But afterwards, it seemed as though there was someone following us.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Someone even broke into our room while we were out and searched our belongings.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: They took great care to put everything back in place as it was, but Mr. Garcia discovered traces of their actions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: S—Scary... So because you wouldn't give it to him, now he just wants to take it!?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: After we discovered our room had been searched like that, we decided to raise enough money to get out of here and return to Petrichor as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Once we arrive, our plan is to contact the other esteemed gentlemen of the Daydream Club and find a way to solve this problem together.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: And Petrichor is... hehe, well let's just say it's Mr. Garcia's home turf.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: For him, there's no safer place to be.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Today is the day that we planned to set off for Petrichor, so we hoped you would come along as protection.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: We never thought we'd run into Ms. Kaia here... For safety's sake, all I could do was have Mr. Garcia take her back to the city.

choices.text: What can I do?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It appears we must delay our departure. Please go find Mr. Garcia, and quickly. Just like I said before...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: With your reputation preceding us on the road, perhaps we'll manage to avoid running into any unnecessary trouble.

choices.text: I'll go over there right away.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Mr. Garcia will apprise Ms. Kaia of the situation. As for what comes next... that will be for Ms. Kaia to decide.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Anyway, we should head back to the city as soon as possible.

choices.text: They're not in any real danger, are they?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: No, I shouldn't think so. Mr. Garcia is still within the Court of Fontaine, and there are numerous Gardemeks on patrol.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: If they intend to use violent means, then we can trust the Maison Gardiennage to take care of the greater part of the problem.

choices.text: How can I help?
Sounds like he was up to no good.

talks.objective: Go to the café with Lutong

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: ...As expected, they're keeping a close eye on Mr. Garcia.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: See the man with the hat in front of him, beside that table next to the counter.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I'm certain that he's the one who's been following us these past few days.

choices.text: I'll go call the Gardes.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: That sounds like the wisest course of action... and there just so happens to be a Garde nearby.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: We reported this case to Garde Menthe before, so she already knows what's been going on.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I'm sure she'll be willing to help us. With a member of the Gardes present, I doubt they'll try anything too extreme.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, please have a word with Garde Menthe. I'll go speak with Mr. Garcia.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Let's get going then.

choices.text: Seriously, just call the Gardes.

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, long story short...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Officer Menthe all that has happened...

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Ah, so it's about Mr. Garcia. I understand, let's head over together.

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: At the very least, let's scare off that suspicious fellow first.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: ...Thank you, Garde Menthe. That scoundrel left as soon as he caught sight of you.

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: I was merely doing my job.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, it appears we must vacate this city quickly, and return to Petrichor with all due haste.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I believe they're gradually losing their patience and may... resort to drastic measures.

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: I shall escalate this matter to my superiors. You should have a response within a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Ideally, we'll be able to assign a few officers to escort you.

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, however, our resources are limited and we have affairs to take care of within the city. So we'll only be able to escort you part of the route, not all the way to Petrichor...

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Also, you should find somewhere safe to stay before you leave. Discussing this matter... may take some time.

choices.text: Leave the escorting to me.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Thank you. With you by our side, they won't dare do anything too rash.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But doesn't Kaia work with the troupe? If you guys go to Petrichor, then what about her?

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: I shall go with them.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Miss, I mean this sincerely, from the bottom of my heart. Please, don't...

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: My dear Lutong, don't even bother. I'm just like your boss, you know — I simply can't be persuaded.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: B—But we have no idea what kind of dangers we may encounter...

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: All the more reason for me to come with you! Or are you intending to abandon me again like last time, left holding nothing but a composition with neither beginning nor end?

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: Moreover, our troupe director is quite curious about your machine-generated music...

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: I'm sure he'd be in favor of my coming along. Very well then, I've said my piece. Where shall we go next?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: J—Just like in Sumeru, Kaia completely steamrolled Garcia...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Garcia doesn't stand a chance against her...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Perhaps it's because Mr. Garcia doesn't even want to win...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: *cough* Lutong! Let us hurry, we must find a suitable place to stay! Preferably somewhere with lots of people.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Somewhere with lots of people... Perhaps we could try...

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: The hotel where our troupe is staying? It's quite busy, and we all know each other.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: If any strangers try to sneak into our midst, they'll be discovered immediately. Also, our troupe director will certainly want to learn more about your Numbering Machine.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Then it's settled! Excellent, all of our problems have been solved.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: All of our problems!?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: #That's that then. {NICKNAME}, please take this. Consider it an advance deposit for your services.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I don't know when we'll be able to set off... but when the time comes, I'm counting on you.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: But... Why do I feel like we have even more problems than before!?

choices.text: I can protect them.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: #At your service, dear {NICKNAME}.

choices.text: What do you plan to do next?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It appears we must ascertain the identity of those people.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Although we've already reported the case to the Gardes, there's little they can do without any leads to follow up.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Plus, the Court of Fontaine is far too large for the Gardes to protect us everywhere we go.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: And now that we've gotten Kaia involved... it's become even more complicated.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I hope Mr. Garcia can convince Ms. Kaia to leave Fontaine. That way, we can proceed with our original plan.

choices.text: Anyway, isn't Garcia's research at a dead end?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It's only a "dead end" insofar as there's no way to further increase performance.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: In terms of practical applications, this Numbering Machine still has many great things to accomplish!

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: It's just, Mr. Garcia has never really concerned himself with such practicalities...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I suspect this may be one of the reasons he suffers so much.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: But it could also be why he plays the part of the frustrated researcher so perfectly...

choices.text: Goodbye.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Thanks, I'm counting on you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: ...What's up? Why do you look so upset?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I... I'm just... It's nothing. Perhaps this coffee is a bit too strong...

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Man
dialogues.text: ...What is it? Has something happened?
